an8.61:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] aṭṭhime bhikkhave puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an8.61:1.3: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pavivittassa viharato nirāyattavuttino icchā uppajjati lābhāya.
an8.61:1.5: tassa uṭṭhahato ghaṭato vāyamato lābhāya lābho nūppajjati,
an8.61:1.6: so tena alābhena socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷiṃkandati sammohaṃ āpajjati.
an8.61:1.8: bhikkhu iccho viharati lābhāya. uṭṭhahati ghaṭati vāyamati lābhāya. na ca lābhī, socī ca paridevī ca cuto ca saddhammā.
an8.61:2.1: idha pana bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pavivittassa viharato nirāyattavuttino icchā uppajjati lābhāya.
an8.61:2.3: tassa uṭṭhahato ghaṭato vāyamato lābhāya lābho uppajjati.
an8.61:2.4: so tena lābhena majjati pamajjati pamādamāpajjati.
an8.61:2.6: bhikkhu iccho viharati lābhāya, uṭṭhahati ghaṭati vāyamati lābhāya lābhī ca madī ca pamādī ca cuto ca saddhammā.
an8.61:3.1: idha pana bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pavivittassa viharato nirāyattavuttino icchā uppajjati lābhāya.
an8.61:3.2: so na uṭṭhahati na ghaṭati na vāyamati lābhāya,
an8.61:3.3: tassa anuṭṭhahato aghaṭato avāyamato lābhāya, lābho nūppajjati.
an8.61:3.4: so tena alābhena socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷiṃkandati sammohaṃ āpajjati.
an8.61:3.6: bhikkhu iccho viharati lābhāya, na uṭṭhahati na ghaṭati na vāyamati lābhāya. na ca lābhī socī ca paridevī ca cuto ca saddhammā.
an8.61:4.1: idha pana bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pavivittassa viharato nirāyattavuttino icchā uppajjati lābhāya.
an8.61:4.2: so na uṭṭhahati na ghaṭati na vāyamati lābhāya.
an8.61:4.3: tassa anuṭṭhahato aghaṭato avāyamato lābhāya lābho uppajjati.
an8.61:4.4: so tena lābhena majjati pamajjati pamādamāpajjati.
an8.61:4.6: bhikkhu iccho viharati lābhāya, na uṭṭhahati na ghaṭati na vāyamati lābhāya, lābhī ca madī ca pamādī ca cuto ca saddhammā.
an8.61:5.1: idha pana bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pavivittassa viharato nirāyattavuttino icchā uppajjati lābhāya.
an8.61:5.3: tassa uṭṭhahato ghaṭato vāyamato lābhāya lābho nūppajjati.
an8.61:5.4: so tena alābhena na socati na kilamati, na paridevati, na urattāḷiṃkandati na sammohaṃ āpajjati,
an8.61:5.6: bhikkhu iccho viharati lābhāya. uṭṭhahati ghaṭati vāyamati lābhāya, na ca lābhī na ca socī na ca paridevī accuto ca saddhammā.
an8.61:6.1: idha pana bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pavivittassa viharato nirāyatta vuttino icchā uppajjati lābhāya.
an8.61:6.3: tassa uṭṭhahato ghaṭato vāyamato lābhāya lābho uppajjati.
an8.61:6.4: so tena lābhena na majjati, na pamajjati, na pamādamāpajjati.
an8.61:6.6: bhikkhu iccho viharati lābhāya, uṭṭhahati ghaṭati vāyamati lābhāya lābhī ca na ca madī ca na ca pamādī accuto ca saddhammā.
an8.61:7.1: idha pana bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pavivittassa viharato nirāyattavuttino icchā uppajjati lābhāya.
an8.61:7.2: so na uṭṭhahati na ghaṭati na vāyamati lābhāya.
an8.61:7.3: tassa anuṭṭhahato aghaṭato na vāyamato lābhāya lābho nūppajjati.
an8.61:7.4: so tena alābhena na socati na kilamati na paridevati, na urattāḷiṃkandati, na sammohaṃ āpajjati.
an8.61:7.6: bhikkhu iccho viharati lābhāya, na uṭṭhahati na ghaṭati na vāyamati lābhāya. na ca lābhī, na ca socī, na ca paridevī accuto ca saddhammā.
an8.61:8.1: idha pana bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pavivittassa viharato nirāyattavuttino icchā uppajjati lābhāya,
an8.61:8.2: so na uṭṭhahati na ghaṭati na vāyamati lābhāya.
an8.61:8.3: tassa anuṭṭhahato aghaṭato na vāyamato lābhāya lābho uppajjati.
an8.61:8.4: so tena lābhena na majjati na pamajjati na pamādamāpajjati.
an8.61:8.6: bhikkhu iccho viharati lābhāya, na uṭṭhahati na ghaṭati na vāyamati lābhāya. lābhī ca na ca madī na ca pamādī accuto ca saddhammā.
an8.61:9.1: ime kho bhikkhave, aṭṭha puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasminti.
